scope: Promoted stateless math functions and exact float(float) signal-flow support

production.note: LF working copy; source-equivalent to the retained CRLF candidate

contracts.fast_trig_precise: MSVC and Clang pass; legacy sine and phase sine are bit-identical; sine/cosine peak error about 2.065e-5 over -100pi..100pi
contracts.fast_trig_fast_math: MSVC and Clang pass; legacy sine and phase sine remain bit-identical; sine/cosine peak error below 3e-5
contracts.msvc_fast_precision_note: The existing 2^24 narrowing assertion fails under /fp:fast in both baseline and candidate; /fp:precise passes.

corpus_rerun_note: Not rerun by request: the delta only relocates the existing fast sine arithmetic, updates its sole oscillator caller, and adds unused cosine functions. Focused tests prove old/new sine bit identity under both compilers and floating-point modes.

post_promotion.function_flow_probe: pass on MSVC 19.51 and Studio Clang 14
post_promotion.fast_trig: pass under fast floating-point modes on both compilers
post_promotion.arithmetic: 227 runtime checks pass under precise floating-point modes on both compilers
post_promotion.selected_models: Harrier sample-identical; Mini raw compile and finite deterministic renders at 44.1/48 kHz

changed_models.IIR: Differences are bounded by the minimum positive float subnormal (peak 1.401298464324817e-45).

decisions: Keep raw automatic promotion exact to float(float); do not add a generic callable operator.
Require a Klang signal on the left of raw function flow; scalar literals should be constants or explicit signal boundaries.
Make abs, sqrt, sqr, and cube stateless value functions while leaving Generic::Function unchanged.
Import common unary standard maths overload sets into Klang and provide signal/Control/ControlMap overloads.
Replace Mini's UE-only FMath::Tanh call with Klang's standard-backed tanh overload.
Permanently undefine hostile incoming abs/sqrt/min/max/clamp macros before standard includes.
Retain existing two-argument min/max semantics; non-unary functions remain ordinary calls rather than signal-flow stages.
Move the retained approximate sine helpers to klang::fast and add cosine from the same polynomial/quadrant reduction; do not add unsourced tan, arc or hyperbolic approximations.
